title: feat(spec)!: strict defineStack judges a packages[] stack per body and counts only the top-level apps no body declares against its manifest
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #32978

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — one face narrows and one widens. Narrowed: a stack carrying `packages[]` whose top level holds an app that no package body declares, beside an app of the package body with the manifest's id (or two such apps), is refused by strict `defineStack`, where it was accepted. Widened: a stack carrying `packages[]` whose top level repeats apps that different package bodies declare (an additive artifact, such as `resolveArtifactCollections` output) is accepted, where it was refused.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — the taught rule (at most one app per package; compose a suite with `composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })`) is unchanged, and no skill or docs page teaches handing a `packages[]` stack to `defineStack`; what moves is which top-level apps strict `defineStack` counts on such a stack. The single-app teaching follow-up of #32898 is #32977.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：严格模式 `defineStack` 判带 `packages[]` 的栈时，改用 `composeStacks` 已有的同一个判法（同一份实现，两道门共用）：每个包体按自己的类型和应用判；只有「没有包体声明的顶层应用」才和 manifest id 那个包体自己的应用一起算到栈的 manifest 下，与加载路径的残余规则一致。
- 为什么改：#32898 让 `composeStacks` 按加载路径的读法判，`defineStack` 还是把全部顶层应用都算到栈自己的 manifest 下，两道门对同一形状判法不同：把 `resolveArtifactCollections` 的输出交回 `defineStack` 会被误拒；手搭一个多出一个未声明顶层应用的栈却会通过，启动时变成一个包两个应用。
- 风险与回滚：一收一放（`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`）。实测本仓与 HotCRM 没有任何产品代码把带 `packages[]` 的栈交给严格 `defineStack`（HotCRM 是每包 `defineStack` 后 `composeStacks` preserve）。不带 `packages[]` 的栈判法不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `validateSingleApp`（新分支）与 `residualSingleAppFinding`（抽成两门共用、按门传入残余应用的来源与改法）；`packages/spec/src/stack.test.ts` 新 describe；`packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.public-reader.test.ts` 新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack.test.ts -t "judged per body"`，预期 4 条全绿，其中一条是「手搭栈的未声明顶层应用与 manifest id 包体的应用一起被拒（422 `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`）」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**One judge for both doors.** `residualSingleAppFinding` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`), added by #32898 for `composeStacks`, is now shared. It reads a `packages[]` stack the way the load path registers it: the apps of the body whose id is the manifest's, plus every top-level app no body declares (the residual rule, `unclaimedTopLevel` in `@objectstack/metadata`, mirrored by the existing `isResidualTopLevelItem`; `packages/metadata` is read, not changed). Two or more of them, at least one residual, are refused. A `ResidualSingleAppDoor` argument carries only what differs per door: the finding's subject, where each residual app came from, and the remedy. The `composeStacks` finding is byte-identical to before (its pins are unchanged and green).

**`validateSingleApp`** (the strict `defineStack` pass):
- **No `packages[]`:** unchanged. Every app counts against the stack's own package.
- **`packages[]`** with an `app` or `module` manifest: the top level goes through the shared judge, the residual apps named as `'NAME' at its top level (apps[i]), which no package body declares`; every body is still judged by `collectPackageBodySingleAppErrors` as before.

Example finding: "A 'module' package must define at most one app, but the stack gives package 'com.example.crm.service' 2 ('crm_service' from its package body (packages[1]), 'crm_field_service' at its top level (apps[0]), which no package body declares): an app that no package body declares is registered under the artifact's manifest id, beside the apps of that package's own body. Keep one app per package: declare each such app inside the package body it belongs to, or give it a 'module' package of its own and compose with composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' }), which registers each package body under its own id — ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended (a suite may surface several apps, one per package)."

**Docblocks.** `validateSingleApp`'s docblock no longer says `composeStacks` judges by "the same rule" loosely: it states the two readings (no `packages[]` / `packages[]`) and that `composeStacks` shares the residual judge. `StackSingleAppViolationError`'s `defineStack` raise-site line and `collectComposedSingleAppErrors`'s docblock say the same.

**ADR-0087.** New semantic entry `define-stack-packages-residual-second-app-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.define-stack-packages-residual-second-app-refused.ts`), no D2 conversion (which package an app belongs to is the author's call). The changeset registers it.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/32978-define-stack-packages-single-app.md`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, BREAKING banner with Before / Now / Unchanged / Fix.

**No error code added**: the refusal is the existing `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (422).

## Tests

New top-level describe in `packages/spec/src/stack.test.ts` ("defineStack — a packages[] stack is judged per body, and its top level by the residual rule composeStacks reads"):

1. accepts an additive artifact whose top level repeats the apps two bodies declare (the reader's shape), under a `module` manifest;
2. refuses a hand-built stack (a preserve artifact plus one undeclared top-level app): `code` `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`, `status` 422, the `defineStack` header, the package, both apps with where each sits;
3. one residual app is accepted when the manifest id's body declares none, two are refused;
4. CONTROL: a stack without `packages[]` is judged unchanged (two apps refused naming the package, one accepted).

New top-level describe in `packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.public-reader.test.ts` (file surface amended by the seat, comment 6846967975): `defineStack(resolveArtifactCollections(composeStacks([app, module], { manifest: 'preserve' })))` passes, with anti-vacuity (two top-level apps under a `module` manifest). The packages share one namespace so the namespace-prefix rule is not what answers (see #33069).

Both arms were reproduced on `origin/main` `157051ce` before the fix with a built probe: the reader round trip was refused `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` 422, and the hand-built stack was accepted.

<details><summary>Ablations (each committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

Taken at `f649a494` (pre-merge head; the merge of `origin/main` touched no line these mutate). Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed) and each restore read `blob == HEAD (6d75946920d3) and git diff HEAD is empty`.

| # | Mutation in `stack.zod.ts` | Expected | Observed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `validateSingleApp` back to the old reading (`const own = true \|\| !Array.isArray(config.packages)`) | additive, hand-built and one/two-residual pins red; control green | 3 failed, control passed |
| 2 | residual predicate ignored in the `defineStack` door (every top-level app residual) | additive pin red | 1 failed (additive) |
| 3 | shared judge stops counting the manifest-id body's apps | hand-built pin red | 1 failed (hand-built) |
| 4 | the no-`packages[]` branch judges nothing | control red | 1 failed (control) |
| 5 | as 1, read by the runtime round-trip pin (`artifact-collections.public-reader.test.ts`) | round-trip red | 1 failed, 2 passed |

The runtime suite resolves `@objectstack/spec` to `src/` (`packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts` alias), and so does `stack.test.ts` (`./stack.zod`), so no dist rebuild was owed per leg.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Measurement (order step 1): no first-party production code hands a `packages[]` stack to strict `defineStack`. In-repo `defineStack(` call sites on a stack value are tests (all `strict: false` or per-package inputs) and authored configs without `packages[]`; HotCRM (`0009f58`, read-only) builds each package with `defineStack` and composes with `composeStacks(packageStacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })`, never re-judging the artifact. The consumer suites below are the empirical half.
- Out of scope, filed by the seat as #33069: with packages of different namespaces (the usual case), the same reader round trip is refused earlier by `STACK_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_INVALID`, because `validateNamespacePrefix` judges the merged top-level copies of body objects against the stack manifest's namespace. Not touched here.
- Ruling-surface grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over `stack.zod.ts`: 68 hits file-wide, one inside the edited regions (the `validateUnmanagedInstallMode` docblock, untouched). No ruling sits on the edited lines.
- Serial: PR #33008 (`renamedFrom`) edits another region of `stack.zod.ts`; this PR touches `validateSingleApp` (~:2690–2760), the `StackSingleAppViolationError` docblock (~:3825) and `collectComposedSingleAppErrors` / `residualSingleAppFinding` (~:8836–8990).

## Verification

Readings at head `0d2b8278` (after merging `origin/main` `12b14462`, which brought #33008), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` (81/81 tasks), every command under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artefacts up to date; tree clean.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 840 passed (840), Tests 26827 passed, 1 todo. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 596 passed (596), Tests 10562 passed, 19 skipped. `typecheck`: exit 0.
